description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers defining the identity constraint set (colour story, type story, logo direction) from a strategy. Should-not covers near-miss neighbors.

queries.q: define the colour story for our brand based on this archetype
what type story fits a challenger archetype in the fintech sector
give me a logo direction for our identity — what mark style and form language fits
assemble the brand identity constraint set from our confirmed strategy
what imagery direction should we use for our brand — subject matter, mood, composition
who is our brand for and how should we position it in the market
generate the actual logo image for our brand
emit the colour tokens as CSS variables and a DTCG JSON file
pick a font pairing for a modern SaaS product with no brand frame yet
check whether this asset is on-brand and consistent with our guidelines
